# Region to Cities: Skylines

> Turns a square of real terrain anywhere into a Cities: Skylines 1 map file (.crp): mapped waterways, a highway and railway to the outside, real forests and farmland, plus ore and oil, listed under New Game with no Map Editor step. An input-based water-risk check warns before export; flagged squares require explicit approval and unavailable checks stop the export. The screen is not native qualification. The map writer (Python) runs in the browser or the CLI with Pyodide. A 1081 x 1081 px, 16-bit heightmap for the Map Editor is available too. Command line: `npx -y __CLI_TGZ__ "<link | preset | lat,lon | place>" --install`, which also copies an approved map into the game's folder. Exit 5 means show the water-risk report, not retry or bypass it automatically.

## For agents

- [Instructions for AI agents](https://region-to-skylines.vercel.app/agents.md): the command, where files go on macOS, Windows and Linux, exit codes, and what to tell the person next.

## Project

- [Web app](https://region-to-skylines.vercel.app): pick a square; the link after `#` records it.
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/frontierkodiak/region-to-skylines) (MIT).
